title: Does Trump Compare To Hitler? Mehdi Asks This Fascism Expert
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
In his new book, _' Shadows of the Republic: The Rebirth of Fascism in America
and How to Defeat It for Good,'_**** lawyer and author Omer Aziz documents the
resurgence of fascism in the United States and lays out a playbook to fight
back against it.

Now, in a timely interview on **' Mehdi Unfiltered**,' Aziz, who most recently
served as speechwriter to Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney, warns **Mehdi**
that "**the much more dangerous part of fascism is the fascists in suits**."

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

"**It is using the machinery of constitutional government in a partisan way to
make it subservient to the political party and then to turn it against
ordinary citizens, dissidents, free thinkers, journalists** ," Aziz says.

Mehdi also asks Aziz about:

  * [Antifascist protesters](https://zeteo.com/p/prairieland-sentences-anti-ice-protests-free-speech-trump) being deemed a domestic terrorism threat by the Trump administration

  * If he agrees with comparisons between Trump and Hitler

  * Elon Musk's [role](https://www.newyorker.com/culture/infinite-scroll/techno-fascism-comes-to-america-elon-musk) in the global fascist project

  * The three most important points in his antifascist playbook

  * His former boss calling Trump's war in Iran "**[worth it](https://www.cbc.ca/news/politics/carney-calls-iran-war-worth-it-9.7240579)**."
